data.description:
## Description
**What**: Extend the draft-3 critic with a heuristic post-pass that scans each producer story's file_impact and body for tag-emit patterns (e.g., --tags <bare-string>, ticket tag <id> <bare-string>), title-prefix patterns (quoted literal title patterns in story bodies), and file-path-convention patterns (paths under tickets-tracker, plugins/dso/docs/contracts/, etc.). When any pattern is detected on a story whose emits_signals is empty, the critic flags the story undeclared-signal and refuses to emit until the author adds a signal declaration OR adds an explicit signals_disclaimer: <one-sentence rationale> field.
**Why**: A story can touch signal-bearing surfaces while declaring zero signals, evading the structural checks entirely. This heuristic post-pass is the first line of defense against that bypass.
**Scope**:
- IN: the heuristic scan over file_impact and story body; the three pattern families; the undeclared-signal flag; refuse-to-emit behavior; the signals_disclaimer escape-hatch field.
- OUT: the three structural checks (draft-3); the inline field schema (draft-2); preplanning fan-in (draft-4).

## Done Definitions

- The post-pass detects a tag-emit pattern in a producer story's file_impact or body when emits_signals is empty and flags the story undeclared-signal ← Satisfies: sc-4
- The post-pass detects a title-prefix pattern and a file-path-convention pattern on a zero-signal story and flags it undeclared-signal ← Satisfies: sc-4
- When a story is flagged undeclared-signal the decomposer refuses to emit until the author adds a signal declaration or a signals_disclaimer field ← Satisfies: sc-4
- A story carrying a signals_disclaimer field with a one-sentence rationale passes the post-pass without an undeclared-signal flag ← Satisfies: sc-4
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic, including one detection test per pattern family and one signals_disclaimer pass case ← Satisfies: sc-4

## Considerations

- [Heuristic-precision] Pattern families are heuristics; the signals_disclaimer escape hatch exists so a legitimate zero-signal story is not permanently blocked.
- [Coupling] This post-pass extends the same critic script draft-3 introduces; build on that scaffold rather than a parallel critic.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a DSO plugin maintainer, I want the decomposer critic to flag undeclared-signal when a producer story shows tag-emit, title-prefix, or file-path patterns but declares zero signals, so that the zero-declaration bypass is closed.
